title: Microsoft Teams: AI phishing detection in chat messages
notes: claim 56: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The rollout details, automatic enablement and documented controls are supported. The risk rationale overstates the evidence by saying detection only warns users; the sources describe possible warnings without establishing that exclusive limit. Licensing should acknowledge the general Teams licence requirement, and the read-only PowerShell command needs its reference cited.
